title: How to Measure Resistance Using Four-Wire Measurement

locator.section: Removing the effects of cable resistance

untrusted_content: Keysight explains that four-wire measurement uses one terminal pair to source current and another pair to independently sense voltage across the device under test. Its stated purpose is to eliminate measurement error from test leads and contact points.

title: Using the DMM Series to Make Simple and Accurate Resistance Measurements
untrusted_content: Tektronix states that two-wire resistance measurement is convenient but causes measurement error, and presents four-wire measurement as a way to avoid that error source.
